gizmo.title: Ukuzilolonga kwezibalo
gizmo.description: Uchungechunge olufushane lwezinkinga zezibalo ezikhiqiziwe ezinempendulo esheshayo. Khetha imisebenzi nebanga lezinombolo; umzuliswano ngamunye umusha.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Igama lalokhu kuzilolonga, eliboniswa esihlokweni sakho.

configure.title: Imisebenzi
configure.description: Izinhlobo zezinkinga ezibuzwayo. Abafundi bangavala noma yiziphi zazo ngaphambi kokuqala.

configure.title: Inombolo encane kakhulu
configure.description: Inombolo encane kakhulu esetshenziswa enkingeni. Izinombolo eziphelele, 0 noma ngaphezulu.

configure.title: Inombolo enkulu kakhulu
configure.description: Inombolo enkulu kakhulu esetshenziswa enkingeni. Izimpendulo zokuhlukanisa nezihlukanisi nazo zihlala kuleli banga.

configure.title: Inani lezinkinga
configure.description: Zingaki izinkinga emzuliswaneni owodwa (1 kuya ku-100).

advanced.title: Umkhawulo wesikhathi
advanced.description: Amasekhondi avunyelwe umzuliswano wonke. U-0 usho ukuthi asikho isibali-sikhathi, okuyikho okuzenzakalelayo: ukuzilolonga okunesikhathi kwehlulisa abafundi abadinga isikhathi esengeziwe. Uma kusethiwe, abafundi basengasivala isibali-sikhathi ngokwabo.

advanced.title: Umbala wokugcizelela
advanced.description: Umbala we-chip yesihloko nezinkinobho. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kulandele itimu.
